strategy.offer: Comprehensive door and gate systems for homes and buildings, including garage, industrial, fire, security, smoke, acoustic and thermal solutions, plus planning support, documentation and training.
strategy.customers: Homeowners, architects, planners, installers, dealers, and operators of commercial, industrial and public buildings needing compliant, customized access and protection systems.
strategy.why_we_win: They combine broad one-source product range, customization, quality-controlled manufacturing, regulatory compliance, and close customer support from planning through delivery.
strategy.resources: Around 850 qualified employees, modern materials expertise, computer-controlled production, integrated manufacturing, continuous product development, and branch and partner coverage.
strategy.direction: Continue improving existing products and developing new technologies to advance flexible, customer-near solutions.
